text:
I had a filling done on the 11th, but it hurts and has a sharp, tingling sensation when I chew. I went back to the dentist on the 17th, a month later, and the pain hasn't subsided. The dentist said that if they removed and redid the filling, it would still hurt, so they didn't remove it completely. They just ground it down a little, saying they didn't have the silver filling material. But I've been in pain for a month, and the dentist just said they didn't have the silver material and that removing it would only cause more pain. They suggested I try another clinic. Seriously? I paid the money, but it feels like I'm not getting any responsibility. I've had to endure tooth pain and sensitivity for over a month. They didn't explain anything at first, they just did the procedure. I feel terrible that I went back and didn't get anything done.
I'm confused because they said they didn't have the material and yet they didn't solve the problem. I feel awful and disappointed.
